resources.string: Experimental beta · OMCP is a draft protocol and has not been independently audited. Not for life-critical communication.
Nearby phones connect over Bluetooth. Your messages wait safely in the queue until a path is available.
Messages use the path shown in each conversation. Add each other as contacts to establish a trusted link.
No nearby peer is connected yet. Turn on Bluetooth, allow Nearby devices, and open Auralis on both phones.
Connect with Auralis or another compatible OMCP client.
Preferences for future Internet relaying. Not active in this beta.
This is live repository status, not a coverage map. Bluetooth range and background operation depend on your devices. Hardware interoperability still needs validation.
Try another name. Message contents are not searched.
Add a contact first. You can then compare safety numbers and manage each conversation here.
Choose a contact to review verification and chat privacy.
Your identity. No phone number required.
Auralis is an independent interpretation of OMCP, built from Open Mesh Chat / Hopla. Open source under the MIT licence. © OMCP contributors.
Point at an Auralis or compatible OMCP contact code. It scans automatically.
NFC contact exchange is not implemented in this beta. Use QR or paste an OMCP contact code.
Your identity is created on this device. Choose a name your contacts will recognise.
Burn after read for this message

Your first message will wait here if your contact is out of range.
TEST MODE · Backup is simulated in memory. Nothing is uploaded to Google Drive. These backups disappear when the app process ends. Do not rely on this mode to recover your identity.
